body:
> Hey @dsbrianwebster – this is likely because Next.js is using Strict Mode, which isn't yet supported in the library with React 18.
>
> Our [`<InstantSearch>`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/instantsearch/react-hooks/) component [reads the URL query params](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/instantsearch/react-hooks/#widget-param-routing) to set the initial state, and *write* the browser URL on unmount to reset it. This is a first-class behavior of the underlying InstantSearch.js library. The problem is that during the second Strict Mode render, the URL has been reset, and therefore the second render is unable to recover the initial state. This breaks URL synchronization.
>
> **We're working on React 18 Strict Mode support this week so you can expect a fix in the coming days.**
>
> In the mean time, could you disable Strict Mode on the `<InstantSearch>` component?

Can you maybe tell us the status of the Strict Mode support and good routing in next?
